Medical History

- Current health concerns and risk factors:  5–6 days of continuous dry, non-productive cough with rhinorrhea; cough disturbs sleep. Chills/shivering (no temperature measured). Generalized myalgias (arms/legs), lethargy/weakness. No chest pain. No day-to-day dyspnea; breathing feels labored only during coughing fits. Initial diarrhea at onset (resolved); no nausea/vomiting; appetite acceptable. Comorbidities: type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), hypertension (HTN). Former smoker (quit ~6 months ago).
- Relevant family medical history:  Father with type 2 diabetes.
- Medications (including OTC or shared medications):  Metformin (dose/route/frequency not documented). Lisinopril (dose/route/frequency not documented). No known drug allergies.
- Immunisation status reviewed:  Not recorded.
- Sexual and reproductive health:  Not recorded.
- Physical activity and nutrition:  Sometimes does Pilates (reduced due to current illness). Diet not recorded.
- Alcohol, tobacco, and substance use:  Alcohol: wine ~2–3 glasses on ~3 evenings/week; counseling provided to reduce. Tobacco: former smoker (quit ~6 months ago). Other substances: not recorded.
- Hearing loss or concerns:  Denies ear pain or discharge; ears feel normal. No hearing concerns reported.
- Mood/mental health (including depression, self-harm risk):  Not recorded.
- Vision problems or recent changes:  Not recorded.
- Family and social relationships, caring responsibilities:  Lives with partner (partner well). Works as IT developer; took a day off due to illness; workload usual.

Assessment & Plan (Integrating DDx)

- Key findings:  50-year-old woman with 5–6 days of dry cough, rhinorrhea, chills, myalgias, fatigue; initial self-limited diarrhea. No chest pain or exertional dyspnea. T2DM and HTN on metformin and lisinopril. Former smoker. No vitals or exam recorded.
- Impression:  Most consistent with an acute viral respiratory infection (upper respiratory tract infection/viral bronchitis).
- Differential diagnoses (aligned with DDx):  
  - Acute viral respiratory infection (high likelihood) given symptom cluster and short duration without red flags.  
  - COVID-19 (moderate) and influenza (moderate) fit the symptom profile; no testing documented.  
  - Community-acquired pneumonia (low–moderate) less likely given absence of dyspnea, chest pain, sputum, or abnormal vitals.  
  - ACE inhibitor–induced cough (low) less likely due to acute onset with viral prodrome.
- Working diagnosis and priorities:  Acute viral respiratory infection. Priorities are symptom relief, rest, hydration, and safety-net follow-up; monitor given T2DM/HTN.

Management Plan

- Treatments/recommendations:  
  - Rest and increase fluids.  
  - Acetaminophen (paracetamol) as needed for fever/aches.  
  - Consider taking 1–2 days off work; reassess return early next week if improved.  
- Safety-net/Follow-up:  
  - Return in 2–3 days if no improvement; sooner if breathing worsens.  
  - If persistent fever and cough at follow-up, clinician may consider antibiotics.  
- Lifestyle counseling:  
  - Alcohol: advised reduction (aim to decrease to two glasses per week initially, then taper further).  
  - Smoking: reinforced continued abstinence.
- Investigations/referrals:  Not recorded.

Consider:

- Allied health referral (EPC – 10 visits):  Not recorded.
- Reproductive or sexual health clinic referral:  Not recorded.
- Mental health support if indicated (e.g., psychologist, AMS support):  Not recorded.
- CTG registration:  Not recorded.
- Preventive health follow-up booked (e.g., flu vaccine, Pap test):  Not recorded.

Summary of Differential Diagnoses (from DDx):

- Acute viral respiratory infection (common cold/acute viral bronchitis) – Likelihood: High. Justification: Dry cough, rhinorrhea, chills/myalgias, fatigue; short course; no dyspnea or chest pain.
- COVID-19 – Likelihood: Moderate. Justification: Dry cough, chills, myalgias, fatigue, transient diarrhea; no testing documented.
- Influenza – Likelihood: Moderate. Justification: Myalgias, chills, fatigue with cough within typical timeframe.

- Missing expected elements: Vitals (BP, HR, RR, SpO2, temperature); full physical exam; BMI/waist; immunization review (influenza, COVID-19, pneumococcal, Td); mental health screening; medication doses/frequencies; detailed smoking history (pack-years); standard drink quantification; hearing/vision screening; urinalysis; diabetes monitoring (HbA1c, kidney function, urine ACR, foot exam); cardiovascular risk assessment; cervical screening and mammogram status; STI risk/screening; social determinants and Indigenous status/CTG registration; domestic safety; other substance use.
- Internal contradictions between transcript and DDx: None noted.
